question: In which state of Myanmar do the Rohingyas primarily reside?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakhine.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rakhine** is a coastal region in the western part of Myanmar, formerly known as Arakan.
 
• The **Rohingya people are a Muslim ethnic minority in Myanmar,** primarily living in the Rakhine State.
 
• The Rohingyas have faced severe persecution and violence in Myanmar, leading to a humanitarian crisis.
 
• The **conflict has resulted in mass displacement, **with many Rohingyas fleeing to neighboring countries, especially Bangladesh.
 
• The international community has raised significant concerns regarding human rights violations against the Rohingya population in Rakhine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rakhine State is geographically significant due to its coastal location along the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The term "Rohingya" is derived from "Rohang," the historical name for the Rakhine region.
 
• International organizations, including the United Nations, have called for accountability and justice for the crimes committed against the Rohingya people.
